svg.aria-label: 01 About. I'm a GenAI engineer with 5+ years of Python behind me: backend APIs first, then classical ML, and now LLM systems. Most of my recent work connects models to the places a company's knowledge actually lives, like SharePoint, Confluence, Outlook and Slack. I also train developers, and I write on LinkedIn about what goes wrong when RAG meets real documents. How I work: Measure retrieval before tuning prompts. A small eval set decides whether a change actually helped. Give agents the fewest permissions that work. Validate tool inputs, and decide the failure path up front. Keep the infrastructure boring. FastAPI, Postgres, Docker, AWS: things the next engineer can run.
